attribution: Fresh delegated Codex source review. Requested backend metadata is recorded; actual backend/model/effort were not independently attested.

source_checks.fit_body_parse_context: wrapped in its intended main function

correctness: Native matcher calls are proposal_, last_, then five earlier decoder layers; matches[1] is the actual final-layer Hungarian assignment. All its matched queries are excluded, including nonroot targets.
Native targets and DFL both filter box_label_mask before indexing. The explicit first-valid-slot==0 assertion makes zeros_like(queries) select the same root box for both native loss_boxes and DFL.

Query and fused Mask IoU use actual superpoint member counts and the same scalar-alpha logit fusion/threshold as the native evaluator. Text alone cannot qualify. Final box IoU must be <=0.5; qualification is detached and called only from training/preflight step.

The additional row block is (10 times native L1 plus 2 times native GIoU plus six-face-mean DFL)/7, averaged over extra candidates in that expression and then actual batch size. Empty rows contribute zero. Existing native denominators, G correction, matched DFL/7, knots, range and clipping remain unchanged.

All model parameters are frozen first, only the existing ten candidate_box_refiner tensors/456102 parameters are unfrozen, and model.eval() plus geometry_head.train() leaves all parents and fresh zero-output R in eval. The complete frozen state, including R, is included in initial/core bookkeeping.

Isolated extra-loss gradients are checked at final centers, final sizes, boundary logits and head parameters. Nonqualified and matched output positions must have exactly zero extra gradient. Updated-head cached replay uses original coarse inputs and the same end_points dictionary, so zero R reads the updated geometry while bbs and Mask arrays are compared on identical upstream tensors.

The deployed complete forward calls the native semantic head once. One explicitly recorded preflight-only replay is an engineering diagnostic. Evaluation uses native bbs and the same selected query for Box/Mask; the extra GT qualification does not enter evaluation or model inputs.

Two preflight steps serialize head delta and optimizer to BytesIO only, restore the complete model strictly, and check all model tensors and optimizer moments/groups/step state. Formal reconstructs the same parents/R and restores the terminal head plus optimizer, with 3723 steps and exact fit-row coverage.

The controller requires completed two-arm preflight and both passing receipts before any full fit subprocess. The deployer remains conditional on closed branch probe, nonempty CPU qualification, nonblocking experiment audit, and this exact source review.

Checkpoint serialization now includes the four existing geometry-factory fields: boundary_mode=distribution, support_arm=whole_range, use_whole_range=True and boundary_loss_weight=1/7. state_delta remains complete replacement values for all ten head tensors; a promoted terminal can therefore be loaded directly by the existing factory. geometry_parent_fit_updates=3723 and total_geometry_fit_updates=3723+step_number disclose the continuation budget, reaching 7446 at terminal.

resolved_findings.issue: Preflight omitted the promised updated-head bbs/Mask invariance witness.
resolved_findings.resolution: Revised fit_body/generated runner cache real refiner/R inputs, update the head, replay only the cached tail, and assert exact native bbs and Mask preservation; diagnostic replay count is separate from deployed head calls.

resolved_findings.issue: Preflight did not require observed empty-row and clipped-target coverage.
resolved_findings.resolution: PREFLIGHT_PANEL selects actual batch1 with counts [28,0,0,1,0,14,100,0] and 126 raw outside faces; both real preflight steps require nonempty qualification, at least one empty row and outside targets. DFL clamps these observed targets to the existing endpoints.

resolved_findings.issue: Full-fit controller checked each arm preflight only when that arm was reached.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both receipts and completed preflight_status are now checked before the arm loop.

resolved_findings.issue: Inherited load metadata described geometry as frozen and required a readback optimizer.
resolved_findings.resolution: Revised runner records geometry_head_only, frozen_parent_and_R and fresh_geometry_optimizer_required after its freeze/unfreeze setup.

resolved_findings.issue: New head checkpoints omitted four metadata fields required by the existing geometry factory.
resolved_findings.resolution: The serializer now writes the existing distribution/whole_range/True/1/7 values and explicit parent/cumulative fit-update counts. No compatibility loader, model change, loss change or runtime execution was introduced.
